_comment: Decisions on pay leads (scripts/find_pay_leads.py, docs/PAY_LEADS.md): a post the current Plum Book export prints
a title for under the post's own agency, in an organisation the matching rules did not tie to it.
A row takes the post out of the OPEN count and keeps the reason beside it; it never publishes a figure.
kind is one of: not_this_post (the export's office is a different office from this node), stamp_not_a_post_of_this_agency
(the node is a copied template title the agency does not carry), needs_a_reviewed_row (the owner says it IS the post;
the pay modules need a reviewed row, which this file does not supply).
Each row: nodeId, name (the node's name when decided; a rename makes the row stale), kind, basis, decidedOn.
